stem_book: The door of an almirah is 6 ft high, 1.5 ft wide and weighs 8 kg. The door is supported by two hinges situated at a distance of 1 ft from the ends. If the magnitudes of the forces exerted by the hinges on the door are equal, find this magnitude. (Take g = 10 m/s².)
reason: Added g = 10 m/s²: printed 43 N needs it (g = 9.8 gives 41.9 N).
work: Each hinge: V = mg/2 = 40 N; H(4 ft) = mg(0.75 ft) ⇒ H = 15 N; |F| = √(40² + 15²) = 42.7 N
